predictive_survival.config.title: Predictive Survival
predictive_survival.config.rescue_profil: Choose a simple preset, or Custom to decide exactly which production-safe rescue methods Predictive Survival may use.
predictive_survival.config.customize_pol: Edit the Custom profile allow-list. These changes remain staged until you press Done on the main settings screen.
predictive_survival.config.policy.title: Custom Rescue Methods
predictive_survival.config.policy.death_: Allow server-valid death-protection items such as totems to be equipped when the predicted timeline requires them.
predictive_survival.config.policy.shield: Allow an already usable shield to block threats when the simulator can guarantee the block in time.
predictive_survival.config.policy.consum: Allow guaranteed defensive consumables such as Resistance or absorption effects when they can save the full predicted timeline.
predictive_survival.config.policy.equipm: Allow modeled emergency equipment swaps when their observed mitigation is enough to guarantee survival.
predictive_survival.config.policy.invent: Allow exact rescue stacks to be selected or swapped from other inventory slots. Turning this off limits automation to items already in usable hands.
predictive_survival.config.policy.main_h: Allow rescue routing to take over the selected main-hand hotbar slot when that is the fastest safe route. When off, death protection is routed to offhand instead.
predictive_survival.config.policy.proact: When one held death-protection item cannot survive a stacked lethal sequence, allow a second one to be armed in the other hand before the first hit arrives.
predictive_survival.config.safety_mode.d: Controls how conservative Predictive Survival is when observations or timing are uncertain.
Restore the selected item or swapped inventory slot after danger is stably gone and the server has reconciled the emergency action.
predictive_survival.config.debug.descrip: Show prediction, contingency plan, timing and executor diagnostics on the HUD.
predictive_survival.config.reset_default: Reset the staged settings to Predictive Survival defaults. Nothing is saved until Done.
predictive_survival.config.save_failed: Could not save Predictive Survival settings. No live settings were changed.
